description.en: A membranous algal thallus divides into flexuous ribbon-like branches with few terminal branchlets.
description.zh: 膜质藻体分成弯曲带状枝，末端小枝较少。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Bosworthia simulans, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Bosworthia simulans 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Broad ribbon branches with limited terminal subdivision differ from Waputikia's thick axis and fine terminal bushes.
distinctness.zh: 宽带枝及有限末级分叉区别于Waputikia粗主轴和细末端枝丛。

modeling_brief.en: Model flattened flexible ribbons in a shallow fossil relief; preserve the documented fork arrangement instead of a shrub analogy.
modeling_brief.zh: 以浅化石浮雕构建扁柔带枝，保留记录的分叉方式，不套用灌木。

uncertainty: Use B. simulans only; former B. gyges is Walcottophycus and not another counted variant.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: The macroalga Bosworthia from the Cambrian Burgess Shale and Kaili biotas
sources.supports: Bosworthia simulans revision; B. gyges moved to Walcottophycus.

sources.title: Middle Cambrian Algae
sources.supports: Original Bosworthia simulans ribbon-like branched thallus description.
